## Overview

This week we investigate relationships between variables. We cover correlation — what it measures, how to calculate it, and crucially, what it does not tell us. We use the palmerpenguins dataset as our main example.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `08-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [08-content.zip](/files/projects/08-content.zip)
